oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: Product decision 10/10/2026 on the P4 open item (option a): until then the planner sent every link into a trim-hidden page nobody ticked to the contact page (traced on tracy-business/j6 1.2.0: module-674.7, module-816.12, module-843.5, module-848.5 → index.php?Itemid=604), against the #1013 rule that links are never moved to Contact.

'a page hidden after the trim is named to the same rule, and a link into it is dead the same way' is ok: deadLinks names links into the trim map's rows and into the ids in `also`, only `also` with no trim map or with trim:false.
